Subject: Post-call: Performance SLO & Private VPC qualification  next steps

Thanks for the call earlier today  good to meet the Acme infra and ML teams. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move the Private/VPC perf qualification along.

Recap of requirements we heard today:
- Latency SLOs: p95 inference latency <= 200ms for short prompts (~256 tokens).
- Throughput: sustained 500 req/s for your peak batch with bursts to 800 req/s for short windows.
- Concurrency: target ~100 concurrent streams.
- Streaming: must support partial-token streaming (SSE) to the client; connection idle timeout ~90s.
- Internal latency budget: networking (VPC peering + transit) should be <= 50ms round-trip between your app tier and the Redwood inference nodes.
- Egress constraints: all model checkpoints and artifact fetches must egress to your S3 bucket in us-west-2; no public internet outbound from inference nodes permitted except to S3 endpoints.

Action items / proposed plan:
1) Acme to share a network diagram and firewalls/NAT egress rules (we need ports 443, 10250 outbound for metrics and health by default).
2) Schedule a connectivity test: we propose Thu 2026-02-12 09:00-11:00 PST for a short network path test and a synthetic inference run (we'll run our test harness).
3) Provide temporary VPN or peering credentials/cutover window so Redwood Ops can run a 30m throughput soak and streaming verification.
4) Redwood (Jordan + Dev) will produce a short test plan and the test scripts (we'll drop them in the shared Drive link below).

Attachments: redwood test scripts (stub), sample test checklist.
Shared links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-network-tests

Please confirm the test window or propose an alternative and attach the network diagram when you have it.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
